record.paper_title: Some problems and conjectures about L2-invariants
record.original_question: If G and H are admissible groups that are measure equivalent with index I(G,H) > 0, must their L2-torsions be proportional with the same index, namely ρ^{(2)}(G) = I(G,H) · ρ^{(2)}(H)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 10.2. Let G and H be two admissible groups, which are measure equivalent with index I(G, H) > 0. Then ρ(2)(G) = I(G, H) · ρ(2)(H).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. An admissible group is a discrete countable group G that is of type FP over Z (i.e., admits a finite type projective resolution of the trivial ZG-module Z), satisfies the Atiyah/determinant conjecture so that the L^2-torsion ρ^{(2)}(G) ∈ R is well-defined, and has vanishing L^2-Betti numbers b_n^{(2)}(G) = 0 for all n ≥ 0; under these hypotheses, the L^2-torsion ρ^{(2)}(G) ∈ R is an invariant of G (independent of the chosen finite model of a classifying space EG).

Two countably infinite discrete groups G and H are called measure equivalent if there exist a standard infinite Lebesgue measure space (Ω, μ) together with commuting measure-preserving free actions of G and H on (Ω, μ), each of which admits a finite-measure fundamental domain. If X_G and X_H are such fundamental domains for the H-action and the G-action respectively, the index of the measure equivalence is
   I(G, H) := μ(X_H) / μ(X_G) ∈ (0, ∞),
which is well-defined up to the choice of coupling.

Question. Suppose G and H are admissible groups that are measure equivalent with some coupling having index I(G, H) > 0. Must their L^2-torsions satisfy
   ρ^{(2)}(G) = I(G, H) · ρ^{(2)}(H) ?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture appears open in general. Lück–Sauer–Wegner (2010, J. Topology Anal.) proved an analogous proportionality result for L^2-torsion under uniform measure equivalence, conditional on a measure-theoretic version of the determinant conjecture (verified e.g. for Bernoulli actions of residually amenable groups). No source found establishes the full conjecture for arbitrary measure equivalence of admissible groups; it remains stated as a conjecture.

status_evidence.title: L2-torsion, the measure-theoretic determinant conjecture, and uniform measure equivalence
status_evidence.snippet: We show an invariance result for the L2-torsion of groups under uniform measure equivalence provided a measure-theoretic version of the determinant conjecture holds.
status_evidence.claim: Only a conditional proportionality result under uniform (not general) measure equivalence is established.

status_evidence.title: Some problems and conjectures about L2-invariants
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture 10.2: admissible groups measure equivalent with index I(G,H) imply ρ^{(2)}(G) = I(G,H) · ρ^{(2)}(H).
status_evidence.claim: Listed as an open conjecture in a recent problem survey on L^2-invariants.
